_what_this_is: Two voices for two rooms of KOWLOON-7 street level. Materials in this world's language; every horizontal anchor is the cable channel at 1.10 m.

cable_channel.line: the surface-mounted cable channel above the floor
cable_channel.sentence: A clearly legible surface-mounted steel cable channel runs continuously corner to corner at exactly 1.10 m above the floor, on every exposed wall surface including the side-wall returns.
cable_channel.label: CABLE CHANNEL 1.10 M ABOVE FLOOR - GATE ANCHOR
cable_channel.why: This block's universal anchor: every room at street level carries the building's surface-run cable channel at one height, on every wall. A painter draws it and the instrument finds it.

noodle_counter_trade.why: The counter is a trade room: it is scrubbed, hosed and hammered on, so its lower wall is metal and its upper wall is what the landlord left.
noodle_counter_trade.walls: corrugated galvanised steel sheet below the cable channel, grease-darkened; above it, stained bare concrete block with faded stencilled lettering and a dead neon tube bracketed to the wall, unlit
noodle_counter_trade.ceiling: a raw concrete slab with black-painted rectangular ductwork and hanging cable bundles
noodle_counter_trade.floor: cracked pale terrazzo with a steel drain channel running across it
noodle_counter_trade.blank: unbroken corrugated galvanised sheet below the cable channel with stained bare concrete block above it

back_office_soft.why: The office is the room somebody sleeps in: it is lined to kill the street noise and it is the one room with the crew's tag on the wall.
back_office_soft.walls: charcoal acoustic foam panels in a grid below the cable channel; above it, painted plasterboard in a dirty off-white with surface-run conduit and a single spray-painted tag
back_office_soft.ceiling: a suspended grid of stained ceiling tiles with two tiles missing and cable trays showing through
back_office_soft.floor: grey rubber studded tile, worn smooth along the walking line
back_office_soft.blank: unbroken charcoal acoustic foam panels below the cable channel with dirty off-white plasterboard above
